title: Count Largest Group
summary: Given an integer n, group numbers from 1 to n by the sum of their digits.
statement: Given an integer n, group numbers from 1 to n by the sum of their digits. Determine the count of the largest group size.
constraints: Group every integer from 1 through n by the sum of its decimal digits.
Return how many groups share the largest size.
hints: Compute every decimal digit sum from 1 through n.
Count the size of each digit-sum bucket.
Find the maximum bucket size and count buckets equal to it.
This directly realizes the grouping and tie count.
editorial: This directly realizes the grouping and tie count.

tests.explanation: Digit-sum groups one through four each have size two, so four groups tie.
The sums one and two each occur once, producing two largest groups.
